children: High U.K. government bond yields or gilt yields could pile pressure on public sector finances ahead of the budget on October 28, Morningstar DBRS' Julia Specht says in a note. The gilt market has faced structural shifts, including reduced demand for long-dated gilts, increased corporate debt supply, and higher sensitivity to fiscal risks, which have led to rising yields, she says. "With the government's fiscal headroom already limited, elevated yields could constrain policy flexibility ahead of key budget decisions." (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
